decision: Both actual isolated P1 schema2 CPU preflights passed once:rc0, eight configurations each,34 FD maps initial/repeat-final, stable digest, per-configuration cross-host match, before/after NPU/PG false and no owner. No NPU or performance qualification; existing gate/deployments preserved.
review: Actual archived cold/main reports have only initial identity. A synthetic legal dependency addition demonstrates a potential exact-initial-digest false rejection, but this is not evidence that the old runs encountered that rejection.

Schema p1-training-2 source-pins the byte-exact existing FD helper. Worker initial/final collectors retain raw map results and all FD objects. Base native/dependency objects and pointwise must match actual loader exact paths, bytes and SHA; dev/inode/segments are validated by the helper.

Actual imported package roots distinguish deep_ep._C from torch_npu._C. Canonical cross-host identity excludes physical inode/path while retaining stable logical roles/hash/bytes; unknown collisions fail closed.

Final collection occurs after case close and before PG teardown, including failure paths. Host-only rank/digest convergence preserves the first body/collector error. No added device barrier, model synchronization or SHMEM protocol change.

All original candidate source/native/execution and base version/precision/source/native/old dependencies remain immutable. Only lazy dependencies/maps may be added. P1 performance consumption requires final exact match to current and complete all-rank final/cleanup evidence; missing-final old reports are not reinterpreted.

Adapter/native/math/thresholds and old reports are untouched. CPU tests include archived P0 routed/shared and CANN gate compatibility, actual dual-C FD fixtures and negative mutations. Modeled final identities used by tests do not confer training qualification.
known_boundaries: Actual revised collector/import/final convergence has not yet run in the target environment.

0310 was manually aborted after new in-flight foreign occupancy. Its raw176 metric pass, missing real exit codes and missing supplemental FD remain separate evidence; this patch cannot retroactively fill gaps.
This is an audit/qualification correction, not a demonstrated fix for1431, a proof of environmental causality, or physical overlap/performance evidence.

CPU_preflight.before_after_require: NPU false, PG false, ElasticBuffer owner none
CPU_preflight.required: All native/dependency and pointwise exact FD binding; both imported package _C; stable repeat identity/final policy; corresponding config identity equal across hosts; exact source pins and actual rc/stdout/stderr.
CPU_preflight.on_error: Stop and preserve raw first failure; no repeated command.
